### :material-code-braces: Template variables

Variables you provide when running the template — `DATA_ROOT` via `--data-root`, the rest via `--var NAME=value`:

| Variable | Required | Description |
|---|:--:|---|
| `DATA_ROOT` | ✓ | proteinfamilies output directory (qc/, mmseqs/, family_reps/, full_msa/, hmm/, phylogeny/, update_families/, multiqc/, pipeline_info/). |
| `METADATA_FILE` | — | The samplesheet the run was started with (--input: sample, fasta, optional existing_hmms_to_update and existing_msas_to_update, plus any design columns). Defaults to input/samplesheet.csv under DATA_ROOT. |
| `METADATA_ID_COL` | — | Samplesheet id column. proteinfamilies fixes it to sample; recorded for the metadata auto-detection. |
| `GROUP_COL` | — | Samplesheet column the dashboard groups and filters samples by. Defaults to mode (create or update), derived from the sheet; name any design column added to the sheet instead. |
| `GROUP_COL_DISPLAY` | — | Reader-facing label of GROUP_COL, used in filter and card titles. |
| `SKIP_PHYLOGENETIC_INFERENCE` | — | Set (--var SKIP_PHYLOGENETIC_INFERENCE=true) for a run with --skip_phylogenetic_inference: phylogeny/ is absent, so the tree collections are removed. |

### :material-chef-hat: Recipes

Each recipe reshapes raw pipeline output into a tidy table. The name links to its source; *Output* lists the validated `EXPECTED_SCHEMA` columns.

| Recipe | Transforms | Output |
|---|---|---|
| [`cmaple/tree_layout.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/cmaple/tree_layout.py) | Per-family Newick trees laid out as rectangular tree segments. | `family`, `sample`, `draw_order`, `x`, `y`, `node`, `is_tip`, `n_tips` |
| [`famsa/alignment.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/famsa/alignment.py) | The protein module's MSA table from per-family aligned FASTA files. | `msa_id`, `seq_id`, `rank`, `aligned_sequence`, `identity`, `coverage`, `sample` |
| [`famsa/conservation.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/famsa/conservation.py) | Per-residue conservation of every family, in its representative's numbering. | `entity`, `sample`, `position`, `residue`, `value`, `category`, `consensus`, `consensus_share`, `occupancy`, `n_members`, `sequence` |
| [`nf-core/proteinfamilies/samples.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/projects/nf-core/proteinfamilies/recipes/samples.py) | Sample hub for nf-core/proteinfamilies: the run's samplesheet, one row per sample. | `sample`, `mode`, `fasta`, `existing_hmms_to_update`, `existing_msas_to_update` |
| [`proteinfamilies/cluster_size_distribution.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfamilies/cluster_size_distribution.py) | Initial MMseqs2 cluster size distribution per sample. | `sample`, `cluster_size`, `n_clusters`, `n_sequences`, `sequence_share` |
| [`proteinfamilies/family_members.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfamilies/family_members.py) | One row per family member, with its identity to the family representative. | `family`, `member_id`, `sample`, `origin`, `is_representative`, `in_alignment`, `identity`, `coverage`, `length` |
| [`proteinfamilies/family_metadata.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/proteinfamilies/family_metadata.py) | One row per protein family: representative, size, seed, model and alignment summary. | `family`, `sample`, `origin`, `size`, `representative_id`, `representative_length`, `sequence`, `seed_size`, `recruited`, `effective_sequences`, `model_length`, `aligned_members`, `alignment_columns`, `mean_identity`, `mean_coverage`, `mean_conservation`, `conserved_share` |
| [`seqfu/stats.py`](https://github.com/depictio/depictio/blob/main/depictio/catalog/seqfu/stats.py) | One row per file SeqFu ``stats`` summarised, with its sample and stage. | `sample`, `stage`, `file`, `sequences`, `total_length`, `mean_length`, `n50`, `n75`, `n90`, `aun`, `min_length`, `max_length` |
